crossRefs.note: If I had not come and spoken to them, they would not have had sin; but now they have no excuse for their sin.
Do you see a man wise in his own eyes? There is more hope for a fool than for him.
Woe to those who are wise in their own eyes, and prudent in their own sight!
“Yet you said, ‘I am innocent. Surely his anger has turned away from me.’ “Behold, I will judge you, because you say…
That servant, who knew his lord’s will, and didn’t prepare, nor do what he wanted, will be beaten with many stripes,
I tell you, this man went down to his house justified rather than the other; for everyone who exalts himself will be…
For if we sin willfully after we have received the knowledge of the truth, there remains no more a sacrifice for sins,
If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Jesus said to them, “If you were blind, you would have no sin; but now you say, ‘We see.’ Therefore your sin remains.
translations.bsb: “If you were blind,” Jesus replied, “you would not be guilty of sin. But since you claim you can see, your guilt remains.”
translations.kjv: Jesus said unto them, If ye were blind, ye should have no sin: but now ye say, We see; therefore your sin remaineth.
translations.asv: Jesus said unto them, If ye were blind, ye would have no sin: but now ye say, We see: your sin remaineth.
